fusion.initialization: Trainable signed scalar routes initially reproduce CLIP's score; all 49,825 weights can learn.

pilot.selection: Among unregularized trials, maximize validation first-choice matches, then minimize validation pairwise loss; ties prefer lower learning rate then larger batch. Include epoch zero and select only using training/validation.

objective: Mean gallery-weighted pairwise logistic loss, sigmoid(8 * (0.5*CLIP difference + 0.5*MLP difference)); no hard MLP score cap.
checkpointSelection: The identical runner selects maximum selection-data first-choice matches with pairwise loss as tie-breaker; optimizer stopping uses selection-data loss with patience 20. Real selection data is held-out validation; overfit selection data is the same training-only batch, explicitly diagnostic.
batchRemainder: A final remainder smaller than half the configured batch is merged into the preceding batch. No observations are dropped or duplicated.

smallBatch.selection: Training-only galleries from distinct meaning families; initially misranked galleries first, then other galleries by stable ID. No validation/test images.
smallBatch.success: Every gallery and pair correct and mean pairwise loss below 0.01; report actual loss rather than equating correct ordering with zero cross-entropy.

samePipeline: Small-batch and full-data final runs call the identical runner with byte-identical recipe JSON, initialization seed, architecture, loss, clipping, regularization, stopping and checkpoint rules; only the supplied datasets differ.
testUse: Choose all hyperparameters and final checkpoint before test evaluation. Post-hoc test curves at every tenth epoch plus the selected checkpoint; no test-dependent retuning.

biasVariance.configuration: Same selected final recipe and runner; original validation/test fixed, initialization fixed.
biasVariance.metric: gallery-weighted pairwise Brier error; empirical fixed-label identity, not identifiable Bayes bias/noise

evaluationStatus: Previously inspected semantic regression fixture, not a new blind test or personal-taste evaluation.
activation: Retain guarded acceptance; do not activate a weaker or unvalidated generic head.
